ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field comprising approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized along the superior trailing edge and distal tips comprising approximately 15% of the area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous high-intensity white bands are mapped along the outer 10-15% of the trailing edge on both lobes. The interior dark region contains approximately 35-45 stochastically distributed high-contrast white focal spots (1-4 pixels in diameter) across the medial and lateral fluke zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 12% of the total vertical bounding box of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern detected along the continuous trailing edge; peaks and valleys range from 5 to 15 pixel depth; serrations are most distinct within the high-intensity white pigmentation zones at the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral sigmoid trajectory; the edge exhibits moderate convexity originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity before terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) distributed across the dark ventral surface; approximately 20 clusters on the left lobe and 18 on the right lobe, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions detected on the lower medial section of the left lobe; contrast is low compared to the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme distal tips of both lobes show irregular pixel density and jagged erosion, indicating minor terminal tissue wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-intensity white 'bordering' that precisely follows the serrated topography of the trailing edge from the mid-lobe to the tips.
